announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or auditor appointments. It signifies standard corporate governance compliance rather than any material change to the company's strategic direction or financial position.

announcements.headline: Company Update & AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement indicates that the company is holding an annual general meeting alongside a corporate update, which typically involves routine governance matters and standard shareholder communications.

announcements.headline: Annual Results for the year ended 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the release of scheduled annual results for the specified financial year. It provides shareholders with a comprehensive review of the company's performance and financial position over the period.
